articles.title: Prazosin after a cat’s urinary blockage: what a placebo-controlled trial did and did not show
articles.summary: A 2021 trial did not find fewer repeat blockages with prazosin. Its results help explain why plausible mechanisms and common use need to be tested against meaningful outcomes.
articles.description: A 2021 trial did not find fewer repeat blockages with prazosin. Its results help explain why plausible mechanisms and common use need to be tested against meaningful outcomes.
articles.evidence_population: Male cats after a first obstruction; 80 randomized and 65 analyzed in the 2021 trial.
articles.evidence_outcome: Repeat obstruction within 30 days: 11/37 with prazosin and 5/28 with placebo.
articles.evidence_limits: P=.27; small analyzed groups and exclusions limit inference. Benefit, equivalence and harm were not established.

articles.title: Maine Coon urinary health: warning signs, litter setup and care questions
articles.summary: Maine Coons can have urinary problems, but that does not establish a unique inherited predisposition. Focus on emergency recognition, facilities that fit your cat and an individual veterinary plan.
articles.description: Maine Coons can have urinary problems, but that does not establish a unique inherited predisposition. Focus on emergency recognition, facilities that fit your cat and an individual veterinary plan.
articles.evidence_population: General feline guidance plus a separately linked UK primary-care breed cohort.
articles.evidence_outcome: Descriptive occurrence and practical resource fit; no breed-specific prevention trial.
articles.evidence_limits: The urinary corpus does not establish an inherited or elevated Maine Coon risk.
